periods.time: vol-11 ch-003 midnight after the final

name.zh: 医务室中的初夜与两人的新关系
name.en: First night in the infirmary and the lovers' new relationship

periods.summary: Ikki wakes near midnight, confirms Stella is safe, and is left alone with her after Shizuku and Alice depart. Stella wakes, accepts her defeat without tears, and says her frustration will fuel next year's challenge. Overwhelmed by love, rivalry and jealousy at the thought of losing Stella's 'strongest' place to someone else, Ikki asks to go beyond his previous restraint. Stella joyfully accepts, and the two consummate their relationship.
periods.cause: The final makes Ikki realize that Stella is both the person he loves most and the rival he refuses to yield to anyone.
periods.outcome: Ikki and Stella's bond deepens from engaged lovers/rivals into a physical relationship, creating new responsibilities toward Shizuku and Stella's family.
periods.significance: A major relationship turning point that directly leads to the Familion visit setup and Stella's resolve to face Shizuku herself.
